g.text: After the Cast and Creator’s Comments, ‘Nobody Wants This’ Can No Longer Ignore Israel and Gaza ◆ ‘Difficult People’ Creator Julie Klausner on Reuniting Billy Eichner and the Gang for a Live-Read of the Movie Script That Never Got Made ◆ A+E Global Media’s Dan Silberman Joins AI Company Sol as Its New Head of Marketing and Communications ◆ ‘The Diplomat,’ ‘Nobody Wants This,’ ‘East of Eden’ Among Series to Take Part in Netflix’s ‘FYSee: The Fall Edit’ Awards Showcase (EXCLUSIVE) ◆ ‘Beast in Me’ Season 2 Casts John Goodman ◆ Skydance Sets Finance Leadership Team Following Paramount-Warner Bros.
